# Dependencies for the record-#40 NanoGPT-speedrun port of the SignMuon/EF21 optimizers.
#
# VERBATIM upstream KellerJordan/modded-nanogpt/requirements.txt (re-verified against
# master on 2026-07-26). Do not edit the package list -- keeping it identical is what
# makes "same environment as the record" checkable.
#
# The `torch==2.10` pin is load-bearing for the 8xH100 build: `kernels` fetches a
# PREBUILT Flash Attention 3 binary from the HF hub, keyed to the exact torch
# version/ABI, so a nonstandard torch can leave FA3 with no matching variant. On an
# nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch container (which ships a dev build like 2.10.0a0+gitXXXX)
# installing this file replaces that torch -- usually the right call, because the hub
# has prebuilts for the release wheel. See "Setup" in README.md for the decision ladder.
#
# The single-A100 build (train_gpt_a100.py) needs NO `kernels` and no FA3: it uses
# torch's own FlexAttention, so it runs on whatever torch is already present.

numpy
tqdm
torch==2.10
huggingface-hub          # data/cached_fineweb10B.py download
kernels                  # Flash Attention 3 fetch (8xH100 build only)
setuptools
typing-extensions==4.15.0
datasets                 # only needed to re-tokenize FineWeb from scratch (data/fineweb.py)
tiktoken                 # only needed to re-tokenize FineWeb from scratch
